class TestAsyncHTTP2ConnectionInit:
    def test_init(self, mock_network_stream, mock_origin):
        with patch('httpcore.http2.h2.connection.H2Connection') as mock_h2, \
             patch('httpcore.http2.AsyncLock') as mock_lock, \
             patch('httpcore.http2.AsyncSemaphore') as mock_semaphore:
            mock_lock.return_value = AsyncMock()
            mock_semaphore.return_value = AsyncMock()
            
            connection = AsyncHTTP2Connection(mock_origin, mock_network_stream)
            
            assert connection._origin == mock_origin
            assert connection._network_stream == mock_network_stream
            assert connection._state == HTTPConnectionState.IDLE
            assert connection._sent_connection_init is False
            assert connection._used_all_stream_ids is False
            assert connection._connection_error is False
            assert connection._request_count == 0
            assert connection._events == {}
            assert connection._connection_terminated is None
            assert connection._read_exception is None
            assert connection._write_exception is None
